interface.name: ukui_effect_v1
interface.description: This interface adds or modifies the surface effect. It provides requests to create effect animation and effect for the surface. Only one effect can be associated for the surface on the same stage.

entry.name: effect_exist
entry.summary: surface already has a effect on the same stage

request.name: create_animation_curve

description.summary: create a new animation curve for effect

request.description: Create a new private effect animation use bezier curves. X1 and y1 correspond to the first control point (P1), x2 and y2 correspond to the second control point (P2). Need to divide the value by 100. The new created animation can only be used by itself.

request.name: create_fade_effect
request.description: Create a fade effect for an existing surface. Values for stage argument are described by surface_effect_v1.stage and can be used together in a bitfield, these stages will use the same parameters.

request.name: create_slide_effect
request.description: Create a slide effect for an existing surface. Values for stage argument are described by surface_effect_v1.stage and can be used together in a bitfield, these stages will use the same parameters.

event.name: builtin_animation_curves
event.description: Emitted after bind surface_effect_v1. Every builtin animation will send an event.

event.name: done

description.summary: sent all builtin animation curves completely

event.description: This event is sent after all builtin animation curves have been sent on binding to the surface_effect_v1 object.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will no longer use this animation object.

request.name: set_animation

description.summary: set animation curve for fade effect

request.description: An 'set_animation' request must be called once per fade effect. It will use default curve when curve set to be null.

request.name: set_duration
request.description: Duration is the time between effect start and end. The default value of fade effect has two different values. Duration is 220ms when used at view map stage, and is 180ms when used at view unmap stage.

arg.name: duration
arg.summary: time between effect start and end

entry.name: center
entry.summary: scale based on the center of the surface as the original point.

entry.name: topleft
entry.summary: scale based on the topleft of the surface as the original point.

request.name: set_scale

description.summary: set surface width or height scale relative to surface original width or height

request.description: An 'set_scale' request must be called once per scale effect. If value is 80, means scaled to 80% of the original width or height.

arg.name: width_scale
arg.summary: surface scaled width when effect start or end.

arg.name: height_scale
arg.summary: surface scaled height when effect start or end.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Value range is 0-100. If value is 80, means the alpha value of surface color is 0.8. It will use default value when not call this request to set opacity.

arg.name: opacity
arg.summary: surface opacity when effect start or end

description.summary: set offset for surface geometry when effect start

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will no longer use this effect object.

request.name: set_duration
request.description: Duration is the time between slide effect start and end.

arg.name: duration
arg.summary: time between effect start and end

request.name: set_position

description.summary: set surface position when effect start

request.description: An 'set_position' request must be called once per slide effect.

arg.name: location
arg.summary: slide effect from one edge of the screen/node to its final destination

arg.name: offset
arg.summary: offset value is surface start position relative to edge of screen/node

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Value range is 0-100. If value is 80, means the alpha value of surface color is 0.8. It will use default value when not call this request to set opacity.

arg.name: opacity
arg.summary: surface opacity when effect start or end

request.name: set_type
request.description: The default value is slide_on_node. location is edge of the node, offset is relative to edge of the node when type is slide_on_node. location is edge of the screen, offset is relative to edge of the screen when type is slide_on_output.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will no longer use this effect object.
